description.value: At 3rd level, a summoner can enter a blood pact with his avatar, calling upon his avatar's inner reserves of strength and ferocity or defense and tenacity. As a swift action, the summoner can cause his avatar to enter a blood pact for 1 minute. The avatar can only have 1 blood pact at a time. The summoner can use this ability a number of times per day equal to half his summoner level. Empower: The avatar gains a +4 morale bonus to its casting stat and a +2 bonus to caster level. Rage: The avatar gains a +4 morale bonus to Strength and Constitution, a +2 morale bonus on Will saves, and a -2 penalty to AC; it cannot use Charisma-, Dexterity-, or Intelligence-based skills except Acrobatics, Fly, Intimidate, and Ride, or any ability requiring patience or concentration. Ward: The avatar gains a +2 dodge bonus to AC, +2 resistance bonus to saves, and DR 2/-, but takes a -2 penalty to attack and damage rolls, with the same skill restriction as Rage. When the blood pact ends, the avatar is fatigued for a minute after.
